title: Plans to Encourage Seniors to Adopt Active Ageing Lifestyle
what_it_is: Plans to Encourage Seniors to Adopt Active Ageing Lifestyle

sections.label: Active Ageing Centres expansion
sections.summary: The number of Active Ageing Centres is being expanded and their operating model transformed to support healthy ageing for seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Further, we are expanding the number of the Active Ageing Centres (AACs) and transforming their operating model to support healthy ageing for seniors.

sections.label: Enhanced Silver Volunteer Fund rollout
sections.summary: MOH and the Council of Third Age will roll out the enhanced Silver Volunteer Fund in the second half of 2023 to support volunteer host organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) and the Council of Third Age will also roll out the enhanced Silver Volunteer Fund in the second half of 2023 to support the growing network of volunteer host organisations offering meaningful senior volunteer opportunities.

sections.label: Funding for active ageing programmes
sections.summary: Funding will be provided for the Active Ageing Centres to run active ageing programmes, which will be tracked.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will be providing funding for the AACs to run the active ageing programmes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is something that we will definitely keep track of.

sections.label: Silver Volunteer Fund opportunities
sections.summary: The Silver Volunteer Fund is intended to create senior-centric volunteering opportunities, including mentoring high-risk youths and art and music therapy for caregivers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In respect of the volunteer opportunities, the Silver Volunteer Fund that I mentioned is intended to create a diverse range of senior-centric volunteering opportunities and this can include opportunities to do mentoring to high-risk youths from low-income families and also, to help caregivers of special needs children with art and music therapeutic programmes.

sections.label: Community partners and capability building
sections.summary: Partners on the ground will be tapped, capability built, and community volunteers and seniors engaged in a whole-of-community effort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: They may want to keep to themselves, for example, as I have said in the speech during the Healthier SG Motion and also, in light of the obligations that the AACs will have to undertake to support the Healthier SG.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We do have very good partners on the ground who have been around for a long time and have built relationships with the seniors, so we will be tapping on that expertise.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But capability will continue to be built and we need to do so, especially in light of Healthier SG as we reach out to more people.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As mentioned, the effort is also in tapping on community volunteers and partners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: That is why it is so important to work with grassroots, with partners on the ground and also to bring in seniors who are already connected and convert them to be volunteers themselves, so that they can also reach out.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I think this is a whole-of-community effort and we will definitely have to reach out for different ideas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are already engagements on the ground, there are already efforts to build capabilities, but this will continue to be a work-in-progress.
